title: Hudson Soft: New Soft Line Up for Sega Saturn
native_title: ハドソン新作プレビュー
overview:
Hudson Soft New Soft Line Up for Sega Saturn, also called Hudson Shinsaku Preview (ハドソン 新作 プレビュー), is a demo disc published by Hudson Soft for the Sega Saturn containing demos of five Hudson games:

• Bulk Slash
• Willy Wombat
• Virus
• Koden Koureijutsu Hyaku Monogatari: Hontoni Atta Kowai Hanashi
• Momotarou Douchuuki
